title: Priced-in evidence-state Taiwan PIT feasibility audit
principle: The market's true incorporation fraction is latent. The observable research object is only the pre-event evidence state available before realization.

preEventEvidence: Prior disclosure stated the conditional FDA review path and possible clinical-hold branch.
Realization date arrived about one month later inside the disclosed procedural window.
witnesses.prohibitedInference: Do not say the October approval was fully priced in; only that investors had official prior evidence that an IND decision/process realization was pending.

preEventEvidence: Shareholder authorization for up to 2,000,000 restricted shares existed before the first issuance.
Regulatory effectiveness preceded the 2026-10-02 board decision.
Exact first-issuance quantity and record date were not frozen ex ante in the evidence used here.
witnesses.prohibitedInference: Do not equate authorized ceiling with expected issuance magnitude.

preEventEvidence: No prior issuer schedule/authorization evidence makes the occurrence an anticipated corporate event under the covered lane.
witnesses.prohibitedInference: Unscheduled does not prove zero market rumor/leakage; absent covered prior evidence remains lane-bounded.

evidenceVector: ex-ante expectation source class from D17-06
pre-event price/volume/attention only when PIT-valid and strictly before realization
antiLeakage: Post-event returns cannot relabel the pre-event state.
A prior price rise cannot by itself prove full incorporation.
Repeated article count cannot by itself prove high expectation because D17-09 may classify republication.
LOW_EXPECTATION_EVIDENCE means little verified prior evidence in covered lanes, not metaphysical proof that nobody expected the event.
The state vector is not a probability of market awareness and not a direct trading sign.

maturityDecision.basis: Taiwan PIT event sources now provide divergent pre-event evidence states—officially anticipated conditional realization, partially authorized but unquantified realization, and unscheduled event—with clocks and versioned event evidence separable before outcomes. This makes the evidence-state construct replayable while preserving the latent nature of actual price incorporation.

exactNext: Prospectively freeze expectation-evidence states before independent realizations.
Add PIT-valid pre-event price/volume/attention only as additional evidence, never as proof of incorporation.
Collect cases where high expectation evidence still produces large reactions and low expectation evidence produces little reaction as falsification controls.
Before L4, test whether this pre-event evidence state adds value beyond D17-06 surprise class, D17-09 novelty and D17-13 schedule state.
